description: Get products Albert Heijn suggests instead of a given product: similar products and substitutes, e.g. when it is sold out or to find a cheaper or organic option. Returns the same fields as ah_search_products. When you mention a product or recipe from the result, link its name to its url.

product_id.description: Product ID, e.g. from ah_search_products or ah_get_shopping_list
